'''AdmiralThrawn36 Tatooine JP Deck (sort of)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[AdmiralThrawn36]]
* '''Published:''' 29 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-L-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber A.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

As Cam Solusar knows- high destinies are killer. This deck drains in Space, Tatooine and still has some nasty destiny draws like my Cloud City Deck submited a month ago.

== Strategy ==

This deck is built for speed, surprise with huge firepower with just a few cards. Ben or Obi-Wan are both good on Tatooine, and I added several cards to make Lando a very powerful character. Han in Falcon is a powerful combo and at times he could with one other character- draw 6 destinies when defending a battle! If with Leia add another two with I Know. Of course this would never happen but my other Light Side Deck has drawn up to 21 total destiny. This deck packs a punch more on the ground than in the air but if needed, Undercover Spies can harass the opponent as needed. Perhaps Lando should be somewhere in the title of this deck- he is the target of Undercover, Gambler’s Luck, his gun, Punch It! (if needed). I plan to hit hard at the beginning, then drain and defend while my opponent attempts and fails miserably to destroy me at my force draining locations. Obi is both easy to get out and I can easily bust out his lightsaber, making him very strong. Rate this deck. Remember- brute force is not needed in this deck- destinies can sometimes provide more power than the starships or characters.
